notes.title: NEW HANEDA GIRL UPDATE ㊥🤖
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone for all the support received after the release of Haneda Girl, we continue working to make Haneda Girl the best experience possible.

We leave here the improvements that brings this new patch:

[list]
[*] Language selector the first time you start the game.
[*] Screen vibration selector from 0 to 10 (before it was on/off)
[*] Hide mouse when playing with controller
[*] Calibrate some Platinum scores
[*] Minor adjustment in Portuguese localization in rank screen
[*] Minor adjustments in Japanese localization in the introduction
[*] Fixed issues with playing on monitors over 60hz
[*] Bug resolution (visuals, controls, phases, etc.)
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169790/Haneda_Girl/

notes.title: Haneda Girl is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]🌸 Haneda Girl is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam! ⚔️ [/h1]
Slice through the system in this explosive pixel-powered adventure!

The wait is over! Haneda Girl, the stylish and frenetic 2D action-platformer from Studio Koba—the minds behind the acclaimed Narita Boy—is now live on Steam!

Step into the shoes of Hane-chan, a tiny warrior with a light katana named "KenChan," and pair her up with M.O.T.H.E.R, a heavily armed tactical combat mech. Switch between them in real time to take down enemies, clear levels, and unleash creative destruction.

[previewyoutube=KdQdMxcSp_8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Two heroines. One mission. Zero mercy[/h2]

Haneda Girl thrives on momentum and creativity. Every fight is a sandbox. Every encounter is yours to master.

⚔️ Prefer the swift precision of a light katana?
💥 Or the explosive chaos of heavy machine guns?

There’s no one way to play. Just your way.

[h2]✨ Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🔄 Swap between two characters in real time for strategic flexibility.
[*] 🎮 Fast, intense, and stylish combat—easy to pick up, hard to master.
[*] 🎨 Cyber-kawaii art style: a fusion of sweetness and destruction.
[*] 🧠 Multiple ways to solve every combat scenario. Get creative!
[*] 🚀 Built for speedrunners and casual players alike.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169790/Haneda_Girl/

notes.title: Haneda Girl launches on May 23rd on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]The waltz of destruction begins May 23th[/h1]

From the creators of [b][i]Narita Boy[/i][/b] comes [b][i]Haneda Girl[/i][/b], a brutal and stylish 2D action-platformer where speed, precision, and creativity collide.

[previewyoutube=K2FtEOKdPGA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]✨ A DANCE BETWEEN BLADE & BULLETS[/h2]

Switch on the fly between two contrasting warriors:
 🗡️ Hane-chan – Small, fast, and fierce. Armed with Ken-Chan, her razor-sharp light katana, she moves like lightning through enemy lines.
 💥 M.O.T.H.E.R – A massive tactical combat mech that speaks in bullet storms and brute strength.

Every fight is a canvas. Every approach is valid. Be sneaky, be strategic, or go full chaos mode. Haneda Girl rewards creativity and style in a high-octane battle system that’s easy to pick up and hard to master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193117/2733c310eb2798b84343651b60757514bfbfc551.png[/img]

[h2]🎮 FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚔️ Fast-paced, expressive combat – Swap characters mid-fight to chain attacks and adapt your playstyle.
[*] 💡 Multiple solutions for every encounter – Outsmart enemies with speed, strategy, or raw power.
[*] 🌸 Kawaii meets carnage – A unique visual style that fuses cute, clean pixel art with explosive action.
[*] 🕹️ For everyone – Built for hardcore speedrunners and casual players alike.
[*] 🔊 Original soundtrack – An immersive audio journey crafted to pulse with every step and slash.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193117/162b987eeb2a6d75391ff61e41fe6de9021e7ad0.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169790/Haneda_Girl/

notes.title: New Haneda Girl demo update available now! ㊥🤖
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193117/aa013b8e041f30e70e05d5334558d8f8dc40f418.gif[/img]

We have corrected the following things in the Haneda Girl demo:

- Collectibles not obtained the icon is painted varies (white outline).
- On the map, on the special screens ICONS are displayed to indicate restrictions (characters, timeattack, ghostmode, etc.)
- Visual revamp of the doors (before it looked like they were floating).
- More actions now score (killing titan against spikes now scores)
- Added a frame to the QuickRestart to give it more visibility
- English correction of all dialogs
- French changed MN to MINUTES
- Relevant bugs fixed:
	- Haneda gets stuck in the map (locked)
	- Bug in the map menu pause as if it was the in-game map.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280910/Haneda_Girl_Demo/
